patterns.note: The site is structured as a continuous vertical stack of full-bleed video sections, each serving as a case study for a client project, creating an immersive, dynamic portfolio experience.
Project titles are presented in a large, clean sans-serif typeface, providing clear hierarchy against the video backgrounds, while supporting metadata uses a smaller, consistent sans-serif.
The user interface employs a stark monochromatic palette of black and white, allowing the rich, high-production-value video content to provide all visual color and depth.

The primary interaction is a continuous vertical scroll, where full-bleed video sections smoothly transition into and out of view, creating a seamless reel of work. The header remains fixed at the top.

Each project section features a full-width video at its top, followed by the project title and a horizontal line of metadata (client, services, agency, year) with an interactive waveform-like element.

technique_notes: The site uses full-bleed video elements as hero sections for each project, leveraging the 'video-hero' technique. These video sections are stacked vertically and scroll directly into and out of view, creating a continuous, immersive showcase. A fixed header overlays the content, ensuring navigation is always accessible.

The overall layout is achieved by stacking full-width content blocks, with minimal padding or margins, allowing the visual content to dominate the screen. Text overlays are positioned consistently below each video, maintaining a clear content structure.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~2x body) are used for project titles, with smaller, lighter sans-serif for navigation and metadata, maintaining a clean, modern hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with full-bleed video sections dominating the viewport and consistent, moderate spacing for text elements below them.

standout: This site's standout feature is its complete dedication to a full-bleed, continuous video reel as the primary content presentation. Instead of static images or text blocks, every project is introduced and showcased through high-quality video, creating an exceptionally dynamic and immersive portfolio experience that prioritizes visual storytelling.
